Author: Jacob5800
Name: Portrait Atelier
Description: Create and apply curated portrait designs from your own character in one click.
Punchline: Make and apply a portrait in one click.
Changelog:
## 0.1.4.1

- Added a Discord join button with a recognizable Discord-style symbol at the bottom of the menu, linked to the community invite.
- Added a portrait-themed plugin icon.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Changelog:
## 0.5.0.15

- Sniper estimated sales/day is orange below 1 and yellow from 1 through 3, warning about slower resale.
- Removed the 25-item history fallback to reduce time spent retrying failed batches. Failed 100-item batches can still split into 50-item groups; unresolved items are retried automatically after the full scan.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Strategy Board Library
Punchline: Search and import strategy board share codes.
Description: Searches a local library of FFXIV Strategy Board share codes and provides a quick copy-to-import flow.
Changelog:
## 0.1.2.2

- Fixed FFXIVStrats URL imports by reading the site's strategy API instead of searching the initial HTML. Strategy page titles and share codes are retrieved directly.
- Added folders and encounter filters, plus Recently used first sorting. Copying a board's code records its use.
- Duplicate-code messages identify the saved board; JSON imports report duplicate counts.
- Added library file export and merge import, preserving folders, favorites and recent-use dates. A timestamped backup of the current library is saved before importing.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Housing Timeout Reminder
Description: A plugin to remind you about your house on FFXIV just in case you forgot to visit it.
Punchline: Remind you to visit your house just in case you forgot.
Changelog:
## 1.0.5.9

- House overview has a Remove from tracking button with confirmation showing the character and house. It stops reminders while keeping the address and visits; enable reminders in character settings to resume tracking.
- Days since visit shows completed whole days without decimals.
- New configurations default to a 1-hour repeat interval for dismissed reminders and a 1-hour snooze. Existing saved choices are preserved.
- Snooze duration has a tooltip explaining that it temporarily hides reminders without recording a visit or changing the demolition timer.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Workshoppa
Description: Dalamud API 15 continuation of Workshoppa. Automates workshop material turn-ins, offers retainer deposits with item exclusions, and can skip cutscenes between production phases.
Changelog:
## 9.3.13.2

- Added an optional WS server-bar button, disabled by default. Enable Show WS server-bar button in Workshoppa settings; clicking it opens the Workshoppa UI. The setting is included in settings backups.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Tug of War
Description: Track Tug of War scores from /random 100 rolls and import current party members into teams.
Punchline: Track team scores from FFXIV /random rolls.
Changelog:
## 0.2.0.2

- Added Undo last scored turn, restoring scores and the turn number and clearing pending rolls for a reroll. Works after a match-winning turn; past chat announcements cannot be withdrawn.
- Winning score is configurable from 1–100, default 3. Team setup is locked during an active match.
- Added clearer current-turn and waiting-team indicators, plus named team presets with save, load and delete.
